title: THE MODEL MADE THE NUMBER
concept: A tiny drone crosses an enormous Kenai cloud deck while one vertical Evidence Column asks what each step of the campaign actually established. Company-reported flight records and observed radar latch two solid nickel hoops. Company attribution mounts as a labeled ClaimChip, while radar conversion runs as a shadowless chartreuse model thread that cannot latch a hoop. The camera then descends below the radar beam and the column ends in a dashed ground-evidence absence labeled NOT REPORTED. The film gives the operation its earned robotics medal, gives the water total its required company-estimate label, and ends one hoop open rather than pretending either success or failure.
palette: electric cyan cloud world, persimmon flare glow, deep spruce terrain, violet observed radar glass, nickel evidence hoops, chartreuse model hairline
light: bright broken storm light becomes a transparent radar glow, then warm late-day sun returns for the fair verdict

fingerprint.palette: electric cyan cloud world, persimmon flare glow, deep spruce terrain, violet observed radar glass, nickel evidence hoops, chartreuse model hairline
fingerprint.metaphor: a vertical evidence column latches solid hoops for observations, carries modeling as a shadowless thread, and ends at a dashed unreported ground link

divergence_note: This film is not another indoor orthogonal instrument story like the August 12 threshold or August 13 powerhouse plate. It begins at aircraft scale inside a luminous cloud world, travels vertically through radar altitude to the ground, and changes stages on nearly every cut. Its spatial signature is atmospheric cross-section and descent, its central movement is a tiny machine against weather, and its color story moves from bright cyan and flare orange through violet observed radar and chartreuse modeling before returning to warm daylight.

angle.thesis: Rainmaker's Kenai campaign was a real Alaska drone-engineering achievement, but its nineteen-million-gallon headline outruns what the measurement system proved because the volume is a company radar-model estimate without ground confirmation.
supporting_facts: Ten sorties in seven coordinated missions released nineteen flares from two drones.
Seven radar features were manually tracked, then processed with an assumed five dBZ subtraction and twenty-seven radar-to-precipitation relationships.
The lowest radar beam was roughly 1,800 to 2,200 meters MSL, and no campaign ground gauges or silver-iodide tracers were reported.
angle.fair_counter_point: The flight execution was substantial, the radar observations were real, seven recurring features are meaningful evidence, and independent SNOWIE research shows the physical mechanism can work under suitable conditions.
runner_up_angles: A pure engineering celebration lost because flight precision is not hydrologic validation.
A pure model debunk lost because the estimate was constrained by real telemetry and radar rather than invented inputs.
A policy call for Alaska as a proving ground lost because one company-reported campaign cannot support a statewide recommendation.

treatment.winner: DRAMATIST PLUS ENTHUSIAST OPENING WITH THE EXPLAINER'S EVIDENCE GAUGE
treatment.judge_reasoning: Four lenses pitched and then challenged each other's two-minute retention plans. The winning hybrid keeps the flare-lit wonder and tiny-aircraft scale of the Enthusiast, the long ground-confirmation loop of the Dramatist, and the Explainer's single evidence-chain spine. Gate 0D replaced the first brass dial concept with a fresh vertical Evidence Column so the film cannot repeat recent instrument silhouettes or let interpretation advance an observation meter. The equation arcade is reduced to one five-second transformation so the middle never becomes homework. The Comedian's stacked cup, coin and calculator metaphors were rejected because multiple throughlines would blur what is observed and what is inferred.
treatment.retention_plan: Act 1 earns admiration for the coordinated operation. Act 2 reveals how a radar observation becomes a company volume estimate. Act 3 subjects the headline to a real test by descending below the lowest beam, then grants the strongest fair countercase through Rainmaker's attributed saturated-column argument, the seven repeated features, and the SNOWIE precedent. The Evidence Column is the only orientation object and the dashed unreported ground hoop carries the viewer through minute two.
treatment.padding_test: Every beat must either advance the flight record, transform the radar data into the estimate, test the estimate against ground confirmation, or change the final verdict. Company history, generic cloud-seeding history and regulatory sidebars are cut.

hook.frame1: A tiny SeedDrone punches through a luminous Kenai cloud carrying one persimmon flare while an immense shadowless chartreuse COMPANY ESTIMATE: ABOUT 19M GALLONS continuously resolves behind it.
hook.headline: THE MODEL MADE THE NUMBER
hook.loopback: The final shot returns to the same cloud crossing, but the headline is now a transparent company-estimate label and the Evidence Column ends at a dashed open ground hoop above a small measuring cup marked NEXT TEST.

audio_arc.note: The bed becomes a radar pulse through the model chain, drops almost to silence below the beam, then returns as warm strings for the fair verdict.

open_loop.what: Did anything watch the estimated water complete the trip from the radar layer to Alaska's ground? The answer lands only after the film descends below the lowest beam and finds that the report provides no campaign ground-gauge or tracer confirmation.

open_loop_2.what: How did seven tracked radar features become the nineteen-million-gallon headline? The answer is the assumed background subtraction and twenty-seven conversion relationships producing a 57.62-acre-foot mean.

throughline.object: the Evidence Column, a vertical three-hoop proof apparatus with solid company-record and radar-observation hoops, a shadowless model thread, and a dashed ground-evidence absence
